hero.title: Finally, technology help that's patient with you
hero.subtitle: Real people right here in the Coachella Valley, ready to help in person or from your own home.
hero.body: We offer one-on-one help with phones, tablets, and computers across the Coachella Valley. Meet with us in person or by video call, whichever is easier for you. Pay what you can. Everyone is welcome.
hero.imageAlt: Two smiling seniors sitting together outdoors, using tablets, with the desert mountains glowing warmly behind them.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.quote: Technology should connect people, not leave them behind.
mission.body: We take the time to explain things clearly, and we never rush you or make you feel silly for asking a question twice. Every session moves at your own pace, and every question is welcome.
mission.imageAlt: The six Coachella Computer Aid regulars standing together smiling: two older women, an older man, a veteran, a young volunteer, and a man using a wheelchair, all warmly lit against a desert backdrop.

whoWeHelp.title: Who We Help
whoWeHelp.intro: Wherever you're starting from, there's a place for you here.

seniors.title: Senior Citizens
seniors.description: Stay connected with family, avoid scams, and learn at a comfortable pace.

disabilities.title: People with Disabilities
disabilities.description: Accessible technology and adaptive tools, set up the way that works for you.

spanishSpeakingFamilies.title: Spanish-Speaking Families
spanishSpeakingFamilies.description: Bilingual support that respects your language and your culture.

veterans.title: Veterans
veterans.description: Help navigating your VA benefits online, video doctor visits, and any technology questions along the way.

lowIncomeFamilies.title: Low-Income Families
lowIncomeFamilies.description: Pay what you can, plus help finding affordable devices — because cost should never be the barrier.

everyone.title: Anyone Needing Help
everyone.description: Whether you're 18 or 98, if technology feels confusing, we're here to help.

services.title: Our Services
services.intro: Six ways we support you, explained in plain terms — not tech jargon.

learn.title: Learn Technology
learn.description: One-on-one teaching at your own pace — phone basics, computer fundamentals, and getting comfortable online.

stayConnected.title: Stay Connected
stayConnected.description: Help connecting with loved ones — video calls, email, and social media.

getConnected.title: Get Connected
getConnected.description: Help getting online — setting up Wi-Fi, understanding internet options, and finding affordable resources.

staySafe.title: Stay Safe
staySafe.description: Protection from scams and fraud — spotting scam emails, keeping passwords safe, and protecting your identity.

deviceSupport.title: Get Your Devices Working
deviceSupport.description: Help when your devices need fixing — Wi-Fi problems, printer setup, and getting a slow computer running smoothly again.

navigateOnline.title: Navigate Online Services
navigateOnline.description: Help using healthcare portals, government websites, benefits, applications, and appointments.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.intro: Getting help is simple — just four friendly steps, and we're with you the whole way.

contactUs.title: Tell Us What You Need
contactUs.description: Call, fill out a form, or visit us in person. No complicated process.

weListen.title: We Listen
weListen.description: We ask about what you're trying to learn and what makes you comfortable.

weTeach.title: We Teach
weTeach.description: Patient, judgment-free help at your pace. We explain clearly.

youSucceed.title: You Feel Confident
youSucceed.description: Learn skills you can use forever. Feel confident with your devices.

payWhatYouCan.title: Everyone Deserves Help
payWhatYouCan.intro: Technology shouldn't be a luxury. Here's how it works:
payWhatYouCan.sliderAriaLabel: Choose the amount you'd like to pay per session, from $0 to $75.
payWhatYouCan.supportingText: If you're able to contribute, thank you — it helps us stay here for our neighbors. If not, we're still here for you. This is community care, not charity.

workshops.title: Community Workshops
workshops.comingSoon: Coming soon to communities throughout the Coachella Valley.
workshops.body: We're planning our first workshops, and we'd like to hear from you. What technology challenges would you or someone you love like help with?

who.question: Who are you filling this out for?

options.workColleague: Someone I work with or support

needs.question: What would you like help with?

details.question: What is the biggest technology problem you're dealing with?
details.placeholder: Tell us a little about it — there's no wrong answer.

thankYou.title: Thank You!
thankYou.body: We've heard you. As we plan our first workshops, this helps us know exactly what to cover. We'll be in touch when workshops are ready.

stayInformed.title: Stay Informed
stayInformed.body: We're building a simple way to sign up for workshop updates right here on the site. Until then, call or email us directly and we'll gladly add you to the list.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.body: Whenever you're ready, we're just a message or call away.

about.tagline: Patient, one-on-one technology help for the Coachella Valley — in person, by video, or over the phone.
